name: Battlefield 1943 Reborn 0.1.33 preview (alpha playtest)
body:
![Battlefield 1943 Reborn: early playtest, alpha, subject to change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TekRantGaming/Battlefield-1943-Reborn/main/docs/images/alpha-playtest-banner.png)

**Alpha playtest build.** Expect bugs, crashes and changes between builds, and stats that reset. Tell us what you find
on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/8eakYSvBZS).

The first public build of Battlefield 1943 Reborn: the Xbox 360 game running natively on Windows, with its online
multiplayer brought back. A fan project, not made, endorsed or supported by Electronic Arts or DICE. **No game files
are included: you need your own copy of Battlefield 1943 for Xbox 360.**

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `BF1943-Reborn-0.1.33-preview-windows-x64.zip` | Players. Unzip it, start `bf1943.exe`, and the first time select your own Battlefield 1943 (Xbox 360) package: the single file in `5841097E\000D0000` from your console's storage, or a folder that holds it. |
| `BF1943-Reborn-Server-0.1.33-preview-windows.zip` | Server hosts: dedicated servers listed for everyone. Needs [Python 3.12](https://www.python.org/downloads/). See [docs/SERVER.md](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/Battlefield-1943-Reborn/blob/main/docs/SERVER.md). |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | The SHA256 of both zips and of the game's three binaries. |

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64 bit) and a graphics card with Vulkan. Everything else is in the
[README](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/Battlefield-1943-Reborn#readme).

## Since 0.1.32

- The runtime's own debug overlays (F3, F4 and the backtick key) no longer open in game.
- The window is titled Battlefield 1943 Reborn.
- New installs show the full performance metrics in the corner; F2 switches between off, FPS only and full.

## What the build holds

- All four maps online, up to 24 players a server, on our own backend: the server browser (official and community
  servers), Play online, Create Private Match and Direct connect.
- Classic and Modern playstyles, each server playing one of them.
- Any frame rate (a limit from 30 to 240 or none), with the camera turning on every frame and soldiers, vehicles and
  vehicle cameras moving smoothly between the game's 30 updates a second.
- Vulkan graphics: render resolution up to 2160p, shadows up to four times the original, FXAA, sharpening, texture
  filtering up to 16x, ambient occlusion, global illumination, and grass on Wake Island, Guadalcanal and Iwo Jima.
- Keyboard and mouse with rebindable keys beside controllers, the mouse aiming vehicle guns and turrets directly;
  controller sensitivity, response, dead zone, inversion, vibration and button remapping; the game's own control
  layouts.
- Our first start setup, main menu, pause menu and settings; Stats and Awards, Achievements and Leaderboards pages.
- The dedicated server package, with its setup window, map rotation and playstyle, listed for everyone.

## Known issues

- Flying a plane with the mouse is very hard: the mouse moves the plane's stick only while it moves, and S holds free
  look in a plane. A new mouse flying mode is being worked on. Controllers fly as on the Xbox 360.
- The first person weapon and hands still move 30 times a second at high frame rates.
- Stats, awards and leaderboards reset when the official backend restarts.
- No HDR, no ultrawide picture (letterbox or stretch), Windows only.
- The builds are not code signed yet: Windows 11's Smart App Control can refuse `rexruntime.dll` ("not designed to run
  on Windows", Bad Image, 0xc0e90002). It is not a broken download.

Battlefield and Battlefield 1943 are trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc. Every download includes the licences of
everything in it, in its `licences` folder.
